text:
Leo (Support): P1 escalation — Prospect 'ClearHarbor' stalled onboarding. Security team sent long questionnaire, biggest blockers: data residency for KV cache, audit logging retention, and whether we can ship a private deployment image for air-gapped eval. They need answers by EOD or they pause pilot.
Mia (CSM): Ack. Thanks Leo — can you paste the exact Qs they flagged? I can coordinate legal/infra.
Leo (Support): Copy-paste of their note:
> 'We require confirmation that logs with PII are not stored off‑site, that model weights remain in-region, and an option for an on‑prem dedicated instance for eval. Provide architecture + retention policy.'
Ashley (AE): Contract allows dedicated/private for enterprise but needs SOC2 clause + SSO mapping. I can surface the segs to legal. Probable ask: 30‑day retention default, but they want 7 days.
Sanjay (CS Ops): Technical options: 1) Hosted with prefix KV redaction + retention override to 7d; 2) Dedicated private with customer VPC (longer lead). Which do they prefer short-term?
Leo (Support): They explicitly asked for an on‑prem image to run in their air‑gapped lab for compliance review.
Mia (CSM): Ok — high risk to renewal if pilot stalls. Proposed comms plan: 
- Immediate: 30‑min triage call w/ customer, AE (Ashley), CS, and eng infra (today 4pm PT). Owner: Mia.
- Within 24h: Send one‑pager mapping each security Q -> short answer + owner. Owner: Ashley + Sanjay.
- 48–72h: Technical deep‑dive + if needed a private eval timeline. Owner: Sanjay.
- Legal follow‑up: loop in contracts for SOC2/DPAs. Owner: Ashley.
Leo (Support): Confirming they want written answer by EOD for the questionnaire — can we commit to the one‑pager timeline?
Mia (CSM): Yes, we can commit if we get infra input now. @Sanjay can you draft the architecture blurb and confirm whether we can provide a container image for air‑gapped eval (and constraints)?
Sanjay (CS Ops): I can draft. Quick note: shipping an image requires legal signoff + small engineering build (2–3 days) to strip telemetry and include offline license; we can offer hosted redaction + dedicated VPC as interim same‑day.
Ashley (AE): I'll start the contract/DPAs thread and ask legal for expedited review. Also scheduling the triage call — sending calendar invite.
oncall-bot: Incident created: CS_ESCALATION-1829993333 assigned to Mia (CSM) — priority HIGH.
Mia (CSM): Thanks. I'll run the triage call, capture their must‑have list, and post the one‑pager draft in this thread. If anyone has a prebuilt security Q&A snippet (retention, KV policies, telemetry), drop it here now.
Leo (Support): Dropping their contact: jane@clearharbor.com — she said pause happens Friday if we don't progress.
Mia (CSM): Copy. Action owners: Mia (triage call), Ashley (legal/contract), Sanjay (infra architecture + interim options), Leo (support liaison). Target: one‑pager in thread by 18:00 PT today.
Ashley (AE): On it.
Sanjay (CS Ops): I'll upload a 1‑page arch sketch and redaction options before 16:30 PT.
Leo (Support): Appreciate the quick turn. Will prep customer context for the call.
Mia (CSM): Closing loop — triage invite sent. Will post notes + next steps after call. :thumbsup:
